message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause is the vendored `slugify` 1.2.0, which drops accented letters. Its changelog says 1.2.1 fixes this, but `vendor/` is off-limits, so I didn't touch it. I changed `src/blog/slug.js` instead. It now removes the accents before calling `slugify`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the same vendored `slugify`, so shop URLs with accented product names will still drop those letters. I left it alone because you only asked about blog posts. Upgrading the vendored `slugify` to 1.2.1 would fix both places and make the workaround unnecessary. That upgrade belongs to the platform team.
